Class StateChain

java.lang.Object
org.roux.token.StateChain
All Implemented Interfaces:
StateModifier
final class StateChain extends Object implements StateModifier
The StateChain combines several StateModifier values. The class is visible only inside this package. A half stays when every modifier keeps it. An empty chain keeps both halves. A null entry in the source list is skipped. // @aa-sdd GK-1069 aetheris-plan-f-174.001.md FINESSE:f-174
